name: Spotify → YouTube
description: Spotify playlists, liked songs and followed playlists from one or more accounts – played from YouTube. Write spotify-youtube as a topic in the YouTube plugin's settings and they show at the top of its front page. Nothing is created on YouTube: the songs are matched to YouTube videos and kept on this server.
requires: The YouTube plugin, switched on. A Spotify app made once on developer.spotify.com (its owner needs Spotify Premium) – see Read more.

settings.label: Spotify Client ID
settings.help: From your app on developer.spotify.com (Dashboard → your app → Settings).

settings.label: Redirect URI
settings.help: Used when no public address is set: add exactly this under Redirect URIs in your Spotify app. Use the port the Couchmate server has on its computer (8787 unless you changed it).

settings.label: Public address (for invite links)
settings.help: Optional. An https address that reaches this server's /plugins/spotify-youtube pages from the internet – e.g. Tailscale Funnel or a Cloudflare tunnel. Lets you send invite links, and log in from any device. Add <address>/plugins/spotify-youtube/callback as a Redirect URI in your Spotify app.

settings.label: Include playlists you follow
settings.help: Playlists made by others. Spotify only gives apps their first 100 songs (from its public page) – copy one to a playlist of your own in Spotify to get them all.
